keyFindings.title: Confirm NIH Access Facts and Keep Institutional Signals Accurate
keyFindings.summary: Marriott’s overview verifies a complimentary shuttle to the Metro and Downtown Bethesda and names NIH, Walter Reed, and American University as nearby access anchors. The live NIH Patient Hotel Shuttles page (Clinical Center patient/family transport) currently lists other Bethesda hotels and does not list Bethesda Marriott / Marriott Pooks Hill. actionsResearchRecord.headline: Confirm NIH Access Facts and Keep Institutional Signals Accurate
actionsResearchRecord.priorityWhy: Official pages already support Metro shuttle and NIH proximity, while an NIH Clinical Center stop for this hotel is not present on the current NIH Patient Hotel Shuttles page.
actionsResearchRecord.whatWeFound: Marriott names NIH, Walter Reed, and American University and verifies a complimentary Metro/Downtown Bethesda shuttle. The NIH Patient Hotel Shuttles page currently lists other Bethesda hotels for patient/family Clinical Center transport and does not list Bethesda Marriott. Hotel-operated NIH service was not verified on the live Marriott overview.
actionsResearchRecord.whyItMatters: Institutional demand signals remain commercially relevant, but inaccurate shuttle claims create buyer and compliance risk. Making verified facts clear may improve decision context; this audit does not claim they caused or will cure the consideration gap.
recommendedSteps: Hotel confirms whether any hotel-operated NIH or Clinical Center shuttle operates today, including hours, eligibility, and destination (campus vs Clinical Center).
Approve exact language that separates: (a) Metro/Downtown Bethesda hotel shuttle; (b) NIH proximity; (c) any confirmed hotel NIH service; (d) NIH-operated patient hotel shuttles.
Map approved facts across overview, sales collateral, and priority partner listings; remove unsupported NIH-route claims.
Verify links, inquiry routing, and live copy against the signed fact sheet.
actionsResearchRecord.supportingParties: Corporate sales; NIH/government sales; operations; Marriott digital content
actionsResearchRecord.suggestedTimeframe: Confirm facts in 2 weeks; approved updates within 30–45 days
actionsResearchRecord.timeframeNote: Timing is proposed and requires accountable-owner agreement.
